title: Cheapest phone in Vietnam: prices and 4G rules (2026)
description: The cheapest basic 4G phones and smartphones on sale in Vietnam in November 2026, iPhone prices, and why a phone without VoLTE cannot make calls since 2G ended.
h1: The cheapest phone in Vietnam: what it costs and which phones still work
intro: The cheapest new phone listed by Vietnam's main retail chains on 20 November 2026 is a basic 4G feature phone from Mobell or Masstel, and the cheapest new smartphones are entry-level Android models from TCL, Xiaomi, Tecno and Honor. Vietnam switched off 2G nationwide on 15 September 2026, so any phone you buy must support 4G and VoLTE to make calls. Check that a cheap basic phone supports VoLTE before you buy it. Prices below come from the main Vietnamese retail chains, read on 20 November 2026.
keyPoints: The cheapest new phone listed by a major Vietnamese retailer on 20 November 2026 was the Mobell M139 4G at {{vnd:250000}} (Điện Máy Chợ Lớn).
The cheapest new smartphone seen on FPT Shop's listing on 20 November 2026 was the TCL 60R 5G 4GB/128GB at {{vnd:2990000}}, reduced from {{vnd:3990000}}.
2G ended nationwide on 15 September 2026: a phone that supports only 2G cannot make calls or send texts, and a 4G phone without VoLTE switched on may not be able to make voice calls.
Phones imported privately ("xách tay") are the most likely to fail on Vietnamese networks, so a phone sold officially in Vietnam is the safer cheap option.
The cheapest new iPhone on FPT Shop's listing on 20 November 2026 was the iPhone 17 256GB at {{vnd:28490000}}. Used iPhone 15 128GB phones sold for {{vnd:11000000-11500000}} in early November 2026.

sections.title: What is the cheapest phone in Vietnam?

blocks.text: The cheapest new phones on sale in Vietnam are basic 4G feature phones that make calls and send texts, made by brands such as Mobell, Masstel and Nokia. The cheapest new smartphones are entry-level Android phones, and in November 2026 the cheapest on the big chains' first listing pages was a 5G model.

According to the Điện Máy Chợ Lớn website, as of 20 November 2026, the **Mobell M139 4G** was listed at {{vnd:250000}}. According to Thế Giới Di Động, as of 20 November 2026, the cheapest 4G feature phones in its range were the Mobell M239 4G and the Masstel IZI 10 4G, at {{vnd:430000}} each.

According to FPT Shop, as of 20 November 2026, the cheapest smartphone on its main phone listing was the **TCL 60R 5G** (4GB RAM, 128GB storage) at {{vnd:2990000}}, reduced from {{vnd:3990000}}. FPT Shop's page showed only part of its range, so a cheaper model may sit further down the list.

According to that list, the **HONOR X6b** 6GB/128GB cost {{vnd:2890000}}, and the **TECNO Spark 30 5G** and OPPO A5i cost {{vnd:2990000}} each. Those prices are older than the table above, so check the shop's page before you go.

blocks.title: Compare the same model across chains
blocks.text: The same phone is often priced differently at each chain. On 20 November 2026 the Nokia 220 4G cost {{vnd:980000}} at Điện Máy Chợ Lớn and {{vnd:1100000}} at Thế Giới Di Động. Discounts change weekly, so check two or three chains' websites for the model you want before you buy.

sections.title: How much is a phone in Vietnam?

blocks.text: A new phone in Vietnam costs from a few hundred thousand đồng for a basic 4G handset to tens of millions for a flagship. Most people buying a cheap smartphone pay in the {{vnd:2990000-4690000}} range, based on FPT Shop's listing on 20 November 2026.

sections.title: Which phones work in Vietnam since 2G was switched off?

blocks.text: Since 15 September 2026, a phone needs 4G (or 5G) **and VoLTE** to make calls in Vietnam, and it needs a 4G or 5G SIM. The Radio Frequency Agency of the Ministry of Science and Technology announced that operators would switch off 2G nationwide from 15 September 2026. Only a few special areas were excepted, such as the Truong Sa and Hoang Sa islands.

According to the [Hà Tĩnh provincial government's report](https://hatinh.gov.vn/vi/bai-viet/tat-song-2g-tung-buoc-hoan-tat-qua-trinh-hien-dai-hoa-ha-tang-vien-thong) of 15 September 2026, phones that support only 2G, and SIMs that do not support 4G or 5G, can no longer call, text or use mobile services. A 4G phone without VoLTE, or with VoLTE switched off, can still use mobile data but may not be able to make or receive calls. **VoLTE** (voice over LTE) carries calls over the 4G network instead of dropping back to 2G.

items: **Viettel** runs only 4G and 5G, because it had already closed 3G, according to [Nhân Dân](https://nhandan.vn/bat-tinh-nang-volte-truoc-ngay-159-post988619.html) on 16 September 2026.
**VinaPhone (VNPT) and MobiFone** switched off only 2G and still run 3G, 4G and 5G, according to the same report.
3G is planned to close from September 2028, according to Nhân Dân, so a 3G-only phone is a poor buy even where it still works.

blocks.text: [Tuổi Trẻ](https://news.tuoitre.vn/why-your-4g-smartphone-could-lose-call-service-as-vietnam-shuts-down-2g-103260901183630326.htm) names the phones at most risk: basic 2G handsets, older smartphones, and phones imported from abroad or not officially distributed in Vietnam. Some imported 4G phones use 4G only for data and drop to 2G for calls, so they can no longer make calls. This matters if you bring a phone from home or buy a cheap one privately.

items.title: Open your mobile network settings
items.text: On an iPhone: Settings, Cellular (Mobile Data), Cellular Data Options, Voice & Data. On a Samsung: Settings, Connections, Mobile Networks. On Xiaomi and Redmi: Settings, SIM cards & mobile networks, then pick your SIM. On Oppo and Realme: Settings, Mobile Network (or SIM & Mobile Network).

items.title: Switch VoLTE on
items.text: Turn on the option called VoLTE, VoLTE calls, Use VoLTE or 4G Calling. According to Nhân Dân, switching VoLTE on costs nothing, and VoLTE calls are charged as call minutes on your plan, not as data.

items.title: Make a test call
items.text: A VoLTE or HD Voice icon in the status bar shows that VoLTE is working. If you cannot find the setting, or calls still fail, the phone probably does not support Vietnam's VoLTE standard.

items.title: Take the phone and SIM to the operator
items.text: Take both to a Viettel, VinaPhone or MobiFone store. Staff can check the phone and SIM. According to the Hà Tĩnh report, an old SIM without 4G or 5G support can be swapped for one that does, and the swap costs nothing under each operator's policy.

blocks.title: "4G" on the box is not enough
blocks.text: Thế Giới Di Động's feature-phone listing on 20 November 2026 showed 4G in the name of 12 of its 19 basic phones and did not mention VoLTE for any of them. Before you pay for a cheap phone, ask the shop to confirm that it makes VoLTE calls on your network, and test a call in the shop with your own SIM.

sections.title: How much is an iPhone in Vietnam?

blocks.text: The cheapest new iPhone on FPT Shop's main listing on 20 November 2026 was the **iPhone 17 256GB** at {{vnd:28490000}}, reduced from {{vnd:28990000}}. According to Thế Giới Di Động, as of 20 November 2026, its cheapest iPhone listed was the iPhone 17 Pro 256GB at {{vnd:31990000}}.

Whether buying an iPhone here beats buying one at home, and what to check on a used one, is covered in [Is it cheaper to buy an iPhone in Vietnam?](/guides/is-it-cheaper-to-buy-iphone-in-vietnam).

sections.title: Where to buy a cheap phone in Vietnam

blocks.text: The safest cheap phones are sold new by the national chains, because those phones are made for the Vietnamese market and should work with VoLTE on local networks. The main chains are Thế Giới Di Động, FPT Shop, Điện Máy Chợ Lớn and Hoàng Hà Mobile, and all of them publish their current prices online.

items: **National chains**: prices on the website, discounts that change often, and a branch in most neighbourhoods of Ho Chi Minh City and Hanoi. Compare the model you want across two or three chains' websites before you go.
**Used-phone shops**: these sell used iPhones and Android phones, often with a shop warranty. Check that the phone makes VoLTE calls with your SIM before you pay.

**Privately imported phones (xách tay)**: often cheaper, but Tuổi Trẻ names them among the phones most likely to lose calls since 2G was switched off. Avoid them unless the seller lets you test a call with your SIM.

**Second-hand from other residents**: people leaving Vietnam sell phones and other electronics, and you can look in the [electronics listings on eno.vn](/c/electronics). Meet in person and test a call before paying.

blocks.text: A cheap phone is only half the cost. For SIM cards, eSIMs, getting a Vietnamese number and what plans cost, see the [SIM and eSIM guide](/esim-vietnam-guide). If you are leaving and want to sell your phone, see [selling up before you leave Vietnam](/selling-up-before-you-leave-vietnam).

faqs.q: What is the cheapest phone in Vietnam?
faqs.a: The cheapest phone in Vietnam is a basic 4G feature phone. On 20 November 2026 the Mobell M139 4G was the cheapest listed by Điện Máy Chợ Lớn, and Thế Giới Di Động's cheapest were the Mobell M239 4G and Masstel IZI 10 4G. The cheapest new smartphone on FPT Shop's listing that day was the TCL 60R 5G. Prices for each phone are in the table on this page.

faqs.q: How much is a phone in Vietnam?
faqs.a: A phone in Vietnam costs from a few hundred thousand đồng for a basic 4G phone to tens of millions for a flagship. Based on FPT Shop's listing on 20 November 2026, entry-level Android smartphones are the cheapest smartphones, mid-range Samsung and Xiaomi phones cost roughly double, and new iPhones cost far more. The price table on this page gives each range.

faqs.q: Can I still use a 2G phone in Vietnam?
faqs.a: No. A 2G-only phone cannot make calls or send texts in Vietnam, because 2G was switched off nationwide on 15 September 2026, as announced by the Radio Frequency Agency of the Ministry of Science and Technology. Only a few special areas such as the Truong Sa and Hoang Sa islands were excepted. A replacement phone needs 4G or 5G and VoLTE.

faqs.q: Why can't my 4G phone make calls in Vietnam?
faqs.a: A 4G phone that cannot make calls in Vietnam usually lacks VoLTE or has VoLTE switched off. Since 2G ended on 15 September 2026, calls run over 4G using VoLTE. Turn VoLTE on in the phone's mobile network settings. If the setting is missing or calls still fail, take the phone and SIM to a Viettel, VinaPhone or MobiFone store to check whether the phone is compatible.

faqs.q: Is an iPhone cheaper in Vietnam?
faqs.a: New iPhones in Vietnam are sold at fixed retail prices by chains such as FPT Shop and Thế Giới Di Động. On 20 November 2026 the cheapest new iPhone on FPT Shop's listing was the iPhone 17 256GB. Used iPhone 15 models sold for much less in early November 2026, according to used-phone shop prices reported by Kenh14. Whether that beats buying at home depends on your country's prices.

faqs.q: Will a phone from my home country work in Vietnam?
faqs.a: A phone from abroad works in Vietnam for calls only if it supports 4G and VoLTE on Vietnamese networks. Tuổi Trẻ warned in September 2026 that phones not officially distributed in Vietnam are the most likely to fail, because some use 4G only for data and drop to 2G for calls. Test a call with a Vietnamese SIM before relying on the phone.

faqs.q: Is it safe to buy a xách tay phone in Vietnam?
faqs.a: A xách tay phone, meaning one imported privately rather than sold through official channels, is often cheaper in Vietnam but carries more risk since 2G ended in September 2026. Tuổi Trẻ and Nhân Dân both name imported phones among those most likely to lose calls. Only buy one if the seller lets you make a test call with your own SIM first.
